seo_title: Simpro vs AroFlo: Trade Project Estimating & ERP Sync (2026)
meta_description: Objective technical comparison of Simpro and AroFlo for trade project estimating, inventory management, and Xero/MYOB ledger integration.
direct_verdict: Simpro is the superior choice for large-scale enterprise trade firms requiring complex project accounting and multi-entity consolidation. AroFlo wins for mid-market businesses needing a lower cost-per-user entry point and tighter, out-of-the-box integration with Xero/MYOB.

comparison_matrix.product_a_spec: Open REST API for custom dev

product_a_pros: Superior handling of complex, multi-stage commercial projects
Extensive REST API for custom ERP/BI tool integration
Advanced multi-warehouse inventory and serial number tracking
product_a_cons: High implementation costs and long deployment timelines
Steep learning curve for administrative staff
product_b_pros: Lower total cost of ownership for mid-sized teams
Highly intuitive mobile interface for field technicians
Rapid deployment with native Xero/MYOB ledger sync
product_b_cons: Limited API flexibility for custom enterprise workflows
Scaling costs can become unpredictable with add-on modules
hidden_gotchas: Simpro often requires significant professional services fees for initial configuration, which are frequently excluded from base subscription quotes. AroFlo's sliding scale pricing looks attractive, but the reliance on add-ons like advanced GPS and AI-Bill scanning can inflate the monthly per-user cost by 20-30% once fully operational. Both platforms enforce strict data retention policies; migrating out of either system involves significant manual export effort as neither provides a native, one-click full database migration tool.
